statement: Nscale's quarterly revenue grew from roughly $37 million in Q1 2026 to more than $100 million in Q2 2026, close to 170% sequential growth.
why: Revenue actually being recognised shows the contracted book is starting to convert into deployed, paid-for capacity rather than staying on paper.

impact.mechanism: Sequential revenue growth indicates GPUs are being installed and sold as capacity, pulling through further accelerator purchases.

evidence.excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue approximately $37 million, Q2 2026 revenue topped $100 million (nearly 170% quarter-over-quarter sequential growth)

confidence.basis: Secondary report of privately disclosed investor figures; the Q2 number is stated only as 'topped $100 million', so no exact level is recorded.
